newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - VideoServer forecast up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - VideoServer forecast up.

text.p: -- Robertson Stephens & Co analyst Paul Johnson said he raised his 1996 earnings estimate for VideoServer Inc to $0.64 a share from $0.58 and 1997 to $0.87 a share from $0.76, reflecting higher revenue and greater profitability in the company's third quarter.

-- Wednesday, the company reported earnings of $0.21 a share on revenue of $13.0 million for the third quarter ended September 30 versus net income of $0.10 a share on revenue of $7.3 million last year.
-- VideoServer provides multi-media conference computer servers and devices that connect multiple PCs.
